title: European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 2 (Auditorium)
summary: Full stream of the second day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
body: The European Research and Innovation Days are the European Commission's flagship event on research and innovation policy. The 2026 edition, the seventh, runs on 10 and 11 November in Brussels and online, organised by the Directorate-General for Research and Innovation.

This stream covers the second day of sessions in the Auditorium. Policymakers, researchers, innovators, business leaders and civil society discuss how research and innovation can strengthen Europe's competitiveness, resilience and technological sovereignty.
why: Ullswater Investments note: the R&I Days are where the Commission sets out the direction of EU research and innovation policy. The debates help companies and consortia read the priorities behind future Horizon Europe calls and the next framework programme, which is useful context when positioning a proposal.
